rows.text: Purr-fect! So glad to see you again, my Emanator. My compass is already directing toward the snacks in your pack!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: *slurp*... Wonder if it's gold snacks or silver snacks this time... Well? If you've got questions, ask away, meow.
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: About the meow-velous path of Trailblaze...

One day, while I was slumbering in the darkness, I found the {RUBY_B#Nameless' Compass}direction of the Trailblaze{RUBY_E#}, and following its guidance, I made my way out of the {RUBY_B#box}black hole{RUBY_E#}. Just like that, I was reborn in a cake form!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: And there are many other little guys like me {RUBY_B#wandering}"exploring"{RUBY_E#} through this cold, vast universe... So, I wanna do something for them.
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Like teaching them to "understand" and "build" the ability to get along with people, finding a family they can {RUBY_B#entrust their tails to}"connect"{RUBY_E#} with, and ultimately living a happy life! That's all I could ever ask for.
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: But we can't just rely on the little ones pretending to be adorable... I mean, working hard! We also need more people like you who are willing to give them a home, meow!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: That's why I want you to become an {RUBY_B#one who adopts them}Emanator{RUBY_E#}, meow!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: About coming over to my place again...
I'll be back again. After all, I'm Akivimeow, meow! And the Astral Express will always be my home...
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Right...? That's right, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Meow! I like you, you're so kind!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: About the cat tree...
Meow, it's a blessing from Aeon, so don't bother to ask where it came from. Just enjoy it!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: If the screws come loose or the glue gives out, just let me know, meow~ Don't worry, even Aeons come with after-sales service, meow~
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Just so you know, I am a responsible, world-class mega-kitty!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: About where you came from...
Meow, where I came from? Didn't I already tell you? I'm the snack form of Akivili, meow!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Actually, does it really matter if I'm the Aeon of Trailblaze or not? Meow~ After all, we're all doing our parts for the Trailblaze.
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: With that kind of identity, more people are willing to listen to my message, and more little ones can find their way home... So I'd rather believe I'm Akivili, meow.
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Meow~ But let's not tell the little ones about this, okay?
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Because they truly believe that there's a compass spinning to guide them home somewhere in the vast cosmos... and that is exactly... me, meow!
rows.speaker: Akivimeow

rows.text: Meow~ Then this audience is over. I'll be resting here for today.
rows.speaker: Akivimeow
